questions.enonce_markdown: Define the 'moment of a force'. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: The **moment of a force** about a point (pivot) is the product of the force and the perpendicular distance from the pivot to the line of action of the force: moment $= F\times d$. Its unit is the newton metre ($\mathrm{N\,m}$).

questions.enonce_markdown: Explain why a longer spanner is preferred to a shorter one, in undoing a nut. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown: The turning effect (moment) is $F\times d$. A longer spanner gives a larger perpendicular distance $d$ between the nut (pivot) and the point where the force is applied. For the same force, the moment is therefore larger; equivalently, a smaller force is needed to produce the moment required to loosen the nut.

questions.enonce_markdown: State two differences between mass and weight. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
| Mass | Weight |
|---|---|
| The amount of matter in a body; a scalar | The force of gravity acting on a body; a vector (directed towards the centre of the Earth) |
| Measured in kilograms ($\mathrm{kg}$) | Measured in newtons ($\mathrm{N}$) |
| Constant everywhere | Varies with the value of $g$ (for example smaller on the Moon) |
| Measured with a beam (lever) balance | Measured with a spring balance (newton meter) |

(Any two differences.) Weight $= mg$.

questions.enonce_markdown: Draw a free body diagram showing all the forces acting on a body falling freely through air. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Represent the body by a dot (or a small box). Two forces act on it, both drawn as arrows starting from the body:

1. **Weight** $W = mg$, a long arrow pointing **vertically downwards**.
2. **Air resistance (drag)** $R$, an arrow pointing **vertically upwards**, shorter than the weight while the body is still accelerating (the two arrows become equal in length when the body reaches terminal velocity).

Label each arrow with its name. The resultant force is $W - R$, directed downwards. *(The diagram is drawn by the candidate.)*
